title: Ravana tempts Seetha
introduction: Ravana vaingloriously extols himself and tempts Seetha with all impossible comforts and luxuries, if she obliges him and comes to Lanka with him, leaving Rama. She curtly dismisses all his baiting and luring.
closing: इति वाल्मीकि रामायणे आदि काव्ये अरण्य काण्डे अष्ट चत्वारिंशः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 48th chapter in Aranya Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
एवम् ब्रुवत्याम् सीतायाम् संरब्धः परुष अक्षरम् |
ललाटे भ्रुकुटीम् कृत्वा रावणः प्रति उवाच ह
verses.iast:
evam bruvatyām sītāyām saṃrabdhaḥ paruṣa akṣaram |
lalāṭe bhrukuṭīm kṛtvā rāvaṇaḥ prati uvāca ha
verses.translation: When Seetha spoke thus Ravana is embittered, and knitting his eyebrows he indeed spoke these rudish words to Seetha.

glosses.meaning: to such Seetha, thus, she who is speaking
on forehead, eyebrow, folding, on making
rude, words, in reply, spoke, indeed.

verses.devanagari:
भ्राता वैश्रवणस्य अहम् सापत्नो वरवर्णिनि |
रावणो नाम भद्रम् ते दशग्रीवः प्रतापवान्
verses.iast:
bhrātā vaiśravaṇasya aham sāpatno varavar.hṇini |
rāvaṇo nāma bhadram te daśagrīvaḥ pratāpavān
verses.translation: "I am known as Ravana, oh, lady with superb complexion, let safety betide you, the highly valorous and ten-headed stepbrother of Kubera.

glosses.meaning: I am, of Vaishravana [Kubera's,] from stepmother, brother - stepbrother
one who is - highly valorous one
to you, let there be safety.

verses.devanagari:
यस्य देवाः स गंधर्वाः पिशाच पतग उरगाः |
विद्रवन्ति भयात् भीता मृत्योः इव सदा प्रजाः
verses.iast:
yasya devāḥ sa gaṃdharvāḥ piśāca pataga uragāḥ |
vidravanti bhayāt bhītā mṛtyoḥ iva sadā prajāḥ
verses.translation: "I am that Ravana at whose sight all the gods together with gandharva-s, evil-spirits, birds and snakes will always be frightened and fleeing, as with the people frightened and fleeing from death.

glosses.meaning: from whose, fear, frightened - at whose very sight

verses.devanagari:
येन वैश्रवणो भ्राता वैमात्रः कारणांतरे |
द्वन्द्वम् आसादितः क्रोधात् रणे विक्रम्य निर्जितः
verses.iast:
yena vaiśravaṇo bhrātā vaimātraḥ kāraṇāṃtare |
dvandvam āsāditaḥ krodhāt raṇe vikramya nirjitaḥ
verses.translation: "I am that Ravana who when infuriated for some other reason took up a duel with Kubera, his brother from stepparent, wherein that Kubera is set up against and completely trounced in a combat.

glosses.meaning: in combat, setting upon, completely trounced.

verses.devanagari:
मत् भय आर्तः परित्यज्य स्वम् अधिष्ठानम् ऋद्धिमत् |
कैलासम् पर्वत श्रेष्ठम् अध्यास्ते नर वाहनः
verses.iast:
mat bhaya ārtaḥ parityajya svam adhiṣṭhānam ṛddhimat |
kailāsam parvata śreṣṭham adhyāste nara vāhanaḥ
verses.translation: "I am that Ravana by whom Kubera, the god for Wealth-Management whose vehicular transport is handled by humans, is tormented fearfully and made to completely abandon his wealthiest place which is presided over by him till then, and I am the one who made that Kubera to flee to the excellent Mt. Kailash where he is somehow living, because I will not cause any harm on Mt. Kailash as I hold it sacred.

glosses.meaning: one who has - humans, as vehicular transport - Kubera
his own [Kubera's place] presided over place

verses.devanagari:
यस्य तत् पुष्पकम् नाम विमानम् कामगम् शुभम् |
वीर्याद् आवर्जितम् भद्रे येन यामि विहायसम्
verses.iast:
yasya tat puṣpakam nāma vimānam kāmagam śubham |
vīryād āvarjitam bhadre yena yāmi vihāyasam
verses.translation: "I am that Ravana, oh, auspicious lady, who just by his valour acquired Kubera's auspicious aircraft known as Pushpaka, whose pilotage is just by the wish of its aviator, with which I will be travelling in skies.

glosses.meaning: by which, in sky, I travel.

verses.devanagari:
मम संजात रोषस्य मुखम् दृष्ट्वा एव मैथिलि |
विद्रवन्ति परित्रस्ताः सुराः शक्र पुरोगमाः
verses.iast:
mama saṃjāta roṣasya mukham dṛṣṭvā eva maithili |
vidravanti paritrastāḥ surāḥ śakra purogamāḥ
verses.translation: "Just by seeing rancour-shot face of mine, oh, Maithili, all the gods will quickly shoot off, even if Indra is leading them, then where is the question of their confronting me.

glosses.meaning: with Indra, at their fore - as leader, [all] gods

verses.devanagari:
यत्र तिष्ठामि अहम् तत्र मारुतो वाति शन्कितः |
तीव्र अंशुः शिशिर अंशुः च भयात् संपद्यते रविः
verses.iast:
yatra tiṣṭhāmi aham tatra māruto vāti śankitaḥ |
tīvra aṃśuḥ śiśira aṃśuḥ ca bhayāt sampadyate raviḥ
verses.translation: "Where I will be staying there the Air-god wafts doubtfully, lest his gusts and blasts may hurt me, and the Sun also effectuates his singeing sunbeams as cooling moonbeams, lest I may abduct his wife Prabha, the Sunshine.

glosses.meaning: one with singeing, sunbeams, Sun, also

verses.devanagari:
निष्कंप पत्राः तरवो नद्यः च स्तिमित उदकाः |
भवन्ति यत्र तत्र अहम् तिष्ठामि च चरामि च
verses.iast:
niṣkampa patrāḥ taravo nadyaḥ ca stimita udakāḥ |
bhavanti yatra tatra aham tiṣṭhāmi ca carāmi ca
verses.translation: "At places where I will be staying or freely moving there the leaves of trees will be less of rustle, lest I may wilt them up, and there the gush of water of rivers too will quieten, lest I may dry them up.

glosses.meaning: I, where, and where, am staying

verses.devanagari:
मम पारे समुद्रस्य लंका नाम पुरी शुभा |
संपूर्णा राक्षसैः घोरैः यथा इन्द्रस्य अमरावती
verses.iast:
mama pāre samudrasya laṃkā nāma purī śubhā |
sampūrṇā rākṣasaiḥ ghoraiḥ yathā indrasya amarāvatī
verses.translation: "My magnificent city known as Lanka is there on the other shore of the ocean, plethoric with all kinds of amenities, as well as with ghastly demons, which city will be on par with Indra's Amaravati, but for meekly gods and meaningless souls.

glosses.meaning: of ocean, on other shore is there.

verses.devanagari:
प्राकारेण परिक्षिप्ता पाण्डुरेण विराजिता |
हेम कक्ष्या पुरी रम्या वैदूर्यमय तोरणा
verses.iast:
prākāreṇa parikṣiptā pāṇḍureṇa virājitā |
hema kakṣyā purī ramyā vaidūryamaya toraṇā
verses.translation: "That gorgeous city is completely walled in with compound walls that are adorned with whitish silver, and its palace-chambers are golden, and its archways are fully jewelled with lapis jewels.

glosses.meaning: with whitish [silver wall,] adorned, with compound walls, completely, covered
full of lapis jewelled, with archways.

verses.devanagari:
हस्ति अश्व रथ संभाधा तूर्य नाद विनादिता |
सर्व काम फलैः वृक्षैः संकुल उद्यान भूषिता
verses.iast:
hasti aśva ratha sambhādhā tūrya nāda vināditā |
sarva kāma phalaiḥ vṛkṣaiḥ saṃkula udyāna bhūṣitā
verses.translation: "It is encumbered with elephants, horses and chariots, well sounded by the sounds of trumpets, and with trees which yield fruits that fulfil all the savours, and it is bedecked with chirrupy pleasure-gardens.

glosses.meaning: elephants, horses, chariots, trodden are its streets [encumbered]
all, cherishes [savours,] with fruits, with trees

verses.devanagari:
तत्र त्वम् वस हे सीते राजपुत्रि मया सह |
न स्मरिष्यसि नारीणाम् मानुषीणाम् मनस्विनि
verses.iast:
tatra tvam vasa he sīte rājaputri mayā saha |
na smariṣyasi nārīṇām mānuṣīṇām manasvini
verses.translation: "Oh, princess, oh, self-respectful lady, if you reside there together with me, hè, Seetha, then you will not think of yourself as one from among human females.
notes: The addressing expression hè, has some significance, as in hè, rām... hè, prabho... hè, bhagavān... This has a signal of reverence than that the usual 'O' or 'oh,' for they are bland expressions of addressing.

glosses.meaning: among females, as one among human [females,] not, you think.

verses.devanagari:
भुंजाना मानुषान् भोगान् दिव्यान् च वरवर्णिनि |
न स्मरिष्यसि रामस्य मानुषस्य गत आयुषः
verses.iast:
bhuṃjānā mānuṣān bhogān divyān ca varavar.hṇini |
na smariṣyasi rāmasya mānuṣasya gata āyuṣaḥ
verses.translation: "Revelling in humanly luxuries, over and beyond in heavenly luxuries also, you will not recollect humanly Rama, whose longevity is lessened.
notes: Vividly: 'you said that you enjoyed all humanly luxuries when you stayed at your in-law's place in Ayodhya, as at 3-47-4... they are nothing when compared with the luxuries I provide in Lanka... they are a + mānuṣān bhogān'super human luxuries...' as well as divyān'paradisiacal...' so you choose yourself between this forlorn state and a stately living...' Ravana spoke this as a perfect tempting debauch.

Ravana as devotee of Lakshmi is saying: 'If you come to Lanka with me and tatra vasatī'while staying there...' another text for the above tatra vasa'you stay there...' mayā ' by me, a servant of yours, suchlike me...' ellipt. samarpitān'submitted, offered offerings...' mānuṣān ca divyām ca bhogān bhunjānā'humanly, and heavenly luxuries, on enjoying...' mānuṣīṇām nārīṇām: dvitīyena ṣaṣṭi'one among human females...' na smariṣyasi'you do not reminisce...'
'You will not count yourself as a human female, if you come over to Lanka and enjoy the humanly and heavenly luxuries, which I, as a humble servant of yours, will offer...'

If you come there, you will not think of mānuṣasya'incarnate as man, Rama...' gata āyuṣasya = gata, āyuṣaḥ= acquired, longevity; 'Rama who acquired a longevity for eleven thousand years... rāmasya'about such a Rama... you will not think about him at all...' ellipt. naḥ sambandhinaḥ'we, the related beings of Rama...' smariṣyasi'you think of...'

'you will stop thinking about humans and other humanly affairs, and you also will not think of Rama alone, but you will think about us, the accursed demons, the dependents and servants of the Supreme Person, Vishnu... and in doing so, your thinking shall lead towards our release from this accursed demon-hood...' Maheshvara Tiirtha.

glosses.meaning: of human, with lessened, longevity, of Rama

verses.devanagari:
स्थापयित्वा प्रियम् पुत्रम् राज्ञा दशरथेन यः |
मन्द वीर्यः सुतो ज्येष्ठः ततः प्रस्थापितो वनम्
verses.iast:
sthāpayitvā priyam putram rāGYā daśarathena yaḥ |
manda vīryaḥ suto jyeṣṭhaḥ tataḥ prasthāpito vanam
verses.translation: "Though Rama is the eldest son, king Dasharatha established his dear son Bharata as king, and because Rama is spineless he is put to flight to forests, and now, what is he and what am I, in matter of sovereignty.
notes: Ravana as devotee says: rājñā'one that rules from within...' like an antaryāmi,'an inner force... i.e., you as Goddess Lakshmi, rājñā'by King Dasharatha...' as an inner force of Dasharatha, you made Dasharatha to select manda vīryaḥ, a priyaḥ, putram, bharatam'spineless, not, the choicest, son, Bharata...' and sthāpayitvā'you made Dasharatha to establish Bharata on throne...' rājñā'by the inner ruler, inner force... by you...' the King Dasharatha is incited to send his jyeṣṭaḥ'eldest son...' also as said in viśṇu sahasra nāmāvali: jyeṣṭaḥ śreṣṭaḥ prajāpatiḥ'eldest, best, ruler of people... Vishnu, is prasthāpito vanam'sent away to forests...

’you are Goddess Lakshmi, an inner-ruler in all beings... though Dasharatha was uninterested to select Bharata you made Dasharatha, as his inner force, to select a spineless Bharata, and Bharata is established on the throne by Dasharatha, through you... besides, though Dasharatha was disinterested to send his dear eldest son Rama to forests, you as Dasharatha’s inner force, made Dasharatha to send Rama, the eldest, best, and the only ruler of people, namely Rama, [as said in Vishnu’s Thousand names,] to forests for the elimination of demons, and thereby to release us from our accursed being... hence you, as inner force of everybody, have to come with me, if Rama’s incarnation is to yield its results...’ Maheshvara Tiirtha.

glosses.meaning: less of, bravery [spineless, because that Rama is spineless]

verses.devanagari:
तेन किम् भ्रष्ट राज्येन रामेण गत चेतसा |
करिष्यसि विशालाक्षि तापसेन तपस्विना
verses.iast:
tena kim bhraṣṭa rājyena rāmeṇa gata cetasā |
kariṣyasi viśālākṣi tāpasena tapasvinā
verses.translation: "Rama is subverted from kingdom, thus dwindled is valour, thus winded down is his anima, thus he has become a pitiable one, thus he became an ascetic as nothing else is there for him to undertake, oh, broad-eyed lady, what do you aspire to do with such a Rama?
notes: When a tempter can convincingly prove that a woman's husband is 'unfit' then only he can succeed in his overtures. His theorematic reasoning is to let down Rama from Seetha's viewpoint, as she has broad-eyes, and she is supposed to see reality: 'Rama is rendered to nothing as said in an age-old saying bhagnā kṛṣe bhāgavatā bhavanti'when manly pursuits fail, he turns out as a sanctimonious person... sanyāsi, bairāg,a friar...' Hence, living with him here will cause only eye-soar in looking at these murky forests, to your wide-eyes... thus, come with me...'

Ravana as devotee says: bhaṣṭa rājyena; bhraṣṭam arīṇām rājyam, yena tena'subverted, enemies', kingdoms, by whom, by him...' 'he who has subverted all the kingdoms of enemies, with such a Rama...' gata cetasā'devoid of inner soul...' He by himself is the Cosmic Soul and no duality of souls occurs in the Absolute Soul. Because He has no duality, there will be no duality in his acts na tasya kāryam, kāraṇam na vidyate... śruti.Then He is tāpasena tapasvinām: tāpasa ina tapasvinām'for ascetics, lord, also an acetic...' because He is lord of all ascetics he must also be one with them...' saha rāmeṇa tvam'with, Rama, you...' ellipt. ayam vijñāpanam'this supplication...' kariṣyasi kim'will you make over, isn't it?

'He who has snubbed down all enemy kingdoms, where enemies are not earthly enemies, and as he has no duality in his deeds, won't you make over this request of mine, in welcoming you to Lanka, to him...' Tiirtha.

glosses.meaning: gone is, his anima [or, dwindled is, his valour]
with him [with such a] Rama, what, you aspire to do.

verses.devanagari:
सर्व राक्षस भर्तारम् कामय - कामात् - स्वयम् आगतम् |
न मन्मथ शर आविष्टम् प्रति आख्यातुम् त्वम् अर्हसि
verses.iast:
sarva rākṣasa bhartāram kāmaya - kāmāt - svayam āgatam |
na manmatha śara āviṣṭam prati ākhyātum tvam ar.hhasi
verses.translation: "I, the king of all the demons, am hit by the arrows of Love-god and came to you in love, and instead of beseeching me to love you, your rejection and speaking this way, is unapt of you.
notes: Ravana, the devotee is saying: 'I maybe the king of all the demons, but kāmāt'longingly, devotedly, zealously...' iha āgatam'to here, he who came...' manmadha śara āviṣṭam pratihere the last word prati'towards' is to be taken as iva'like, as though, deem...' then 'deeming me as though I am hit by the arrows of Love-god and talking nonsense...' svayam'you personally... in your right mind' ākhyātum na arhasi 'to say so, is inapt of you...'

"I may be a king of all the demons in universes, but I am a zealotry devotee of yours... but deeming me to be one who is hit by the arrows of Love-god and thus speaking nonsense... this way of your thinking of me and speaking to me, is unapt of you in the right your mind...' Maheshvara Tiirtha.

glosses.meaning: to speak - or, pratikhyaatum = to reject

verses.devanagari:
प्रति आख्याय हि माम् भीरु परितापम् गमिष्यसि |
चरणेन अभिहत्य इव पुरूरवसम् ऊर्वशी
verses.iast:
prati ākhyāya hi mām bhīru paritāpam gamiṣyasi |
caraṇena abhihatya iva purūravasam ūrvaśī
verses.translation: "Oh, modest lady, on refusing me you surely become remorseful like Uurvashi who once kicked Puruurava with her feet.
notes: Uurvashi is one among the four celestial chief maidens, apsara-s, namely, Uurvashi, Rambha, Menaka and Tiolottama. When Vishnu was in His meditation all the other apsara-s came to Him to disturb His meditation. Knowing that, Vishnu gave birth to this Uurvashi from his things. Thus, she is called the one who came from thighs ūruḥ'from thighs...' and this word is defined as uru vaṣṭi'muchly, splendorous one...' Then the other apsara-s had to accept ashamedly that Uurvashi is a beauty of higher order. Kalidasa took this as his subject for his drama 'Vikramorvashiiyam.'

glosses.meaning: remorse, you enter - you become remorseful.

verses.devanagari:
अंगुल्या न समो रामो मम युद्धे स मानुषः |
तव भाग्येन् संप्राप्तम् भजस्व वरवर्णिनि
verses.iast:
aṃgulyā na samo rāmo mama yuddhe sa mānuṣaḥ |
tava bhāgyen samprāptam bhajasva varavar.hṇini
verses.translation: "He that Rama is merely a human, and in war he equals me not by my finger, oh, richly colourful lady, and I chanced here merely by your serendipity, thus you honour me and my desire to possess you..." Thus Ravana spoke to Seetha.
notes: 'Serendipity' is the faculty of making happy and unexpected discoveries by accident... coined by Horace Walpole [1754] after The Three Princes of Serendip [now Sri Lanka,] a fairy tale. Now as a Lankan, let Ravana also say so.

Ravana, the devotee is saying: yuddhe'in war...' yasya angulyāḥ samaḥ ko api na asti'whose, finger, equalling, whoever, even, not, there...' yaḥ saḥ rāmaḥ' who, he, is Rama... or, Vishnu Himself...' mānuṣaḥ'humanly incarnate...' tam'him, such a Rama...' mama bhāgyena'by my, fortune...' samprāptam'presently' let that Rama arrive [in Lanka...]' bhajasva'him, that Rama, you hold him in honour...'

"In battlefield none can match that Rama even by his little finger, for He is none other than Vishnu, and such a Vishnu chanced here in the human incarnation as Rama, and let fortune betide me and let that Rama arrive in my Lanka, and you be instrumental to his arrival, then you may hold that Rama in high honour... for all this to happen first you come with me..." Maheshvara Tiirtha.

glosses.meaning: my, finger, equal to, not - he is not
by your, serendipity [good fortune,] chanced, [me] you honour.

verses.devanagari:
एवम् उक्ता तु वैदेही क्रुद्धा संरक्त लोचना |
अब्रवीत् परुषम् वाक्यम् रहिते राक्षस अधिपम्
verses.iast:
evam uktā tu vaidehī kruddhā saṃrakta locanā |
abravīt paruṣam vākyam rahite rākṣasa adhipam
verses.translation: Vaidehi who is spoken thus is infuriated on her part and with her eyes bloodshot spoke these bitter words to the king of demons in that lonely lace.
notes: The lonely place is an advantageous place for such tempters. But if the tempted is self-controlled, nothing adverse can happen. rāgam viviktā iti vardhayanti'inclination increases in isolation...' But Seetha is disinclined to any such advances or lures or temptations. Some discussion is there in endnote.

glosses.meaning: thus, spoken to, Vaidehi, on her part
to demon's, king paruSam vaakyam abraviit = bitter, words, she spoke.

verses.devanagari:
कथम् वैश्रवणम् देवम् सर्व देव नमस्कृतम् |
भ्रातरम् व्यपदिश्य त्वम् अशुभम् कर्तुम् इच्छसि
verses.iast:
katham vaiśravaṇam devam sarva deva namaskṛtam |
bhrātaram vyapadiśya tvam aśubham kartum icchasi
verses.translation: "How you wish to commit sins although saying that Kubera, a god reverenced by all of the gods, is your brother?

glosses.meaning: brother, by making known - telling his name
un, holy [sinful acts,] to commit, how, you wish to.

verses.devanagari:
अवश्यम् विनशिष्यन्ति सर्वे रावण राक्षसाः |
येषाम् त्वम् कर्कशो राजा दुर्बुद्धिः अजित इन्द्रियः
verses.iast:
avaśyam vinaśiṣyanti sarve rāvaṇa rākṣasāḥ |
yeṣām tvam karkaśo rājā dur.hbuddhiḥ ajita indriyaḥ
verses.translation: "All the demons will perforce get completely destroyed, oh, Ravana, for whom you the cruel and culpable one with uncontrolled senses is the king, and you will be blameworthy for the elimination of righteous demons like Vibheeshana, et al.

glosses.meaning: to whom, you are a king

verses.devanagari:
अपहृत्य शचीम् भार्याम् शक्यम् इन्द्रस्य जीवितुम् |
न हि रामस्य भार्याम् माम् अपनीय अस्ति जीवितम्
verses.iast:
apahṛtya śacīm bhāryām śakyam indrasya jīvitum |
na hi rāmasya bhāryām mām apanīya asti jīvitam
verses.translation: "It may be possible to live after abducting Shaci Devi, the wife of Indra, somehow and anyhow there will be no liveability after abducting me, the wife of Rama.

glosses.meaning: to live on, it possible to
liveability na asti hi = not, is there, indeed.

verses.devanagari:
जीवेत् चिरम् वज्र धरस्य हस्तात्
शचीम् प्रधृष्य अप्रतिरूप रूपाम् |
न मा दृशीम् राक्षस धर्षयित्वा
पीत अमृतस्य अपि तव अस्ति मोक्षः
verses.iast:
jīvet ciram vajra dharasya hastāt
śacīm pradhṛṣya apratirūpa rūpām |
na mā dṛśīm rākṣasa dhar.hṣayitvā
pīta amṛtasya api tava asti mokṣaḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, demon, un-mirrored is the prettiness of prettyish Shaci Devi, and one may live long on forcibly snatching her away from the hands of the wielder of Thunderbolt, Indra, but to him who intimidates or abuses me or women like me, there will be no moksha, release from the cycle of rebirth, even if he has consumed amR^ita ambrosia." Thus Seetha spoke to Ravana.
notes: Seetha iterated twice about Shaci Devi for reinforcing her argument. She did not say 'on abducting me you will not survive...' but said 'on abducting me, or women like me...' this is to say that any husband devote-wife is not to be subjected to such humiliation. Further, this is for aślīla nivāraṇa artham 'to avoid obscenity from the mouth of this principal character in legend....' Govindaraja. As Seetha is unsure whether Ravana consumed ambrosia or not, but, 'if your-like malicious minded beings, though they have gulped amṛta 'ambrosia' there is no mokśa 'release, deliverance...' from death-birth cycle and that mokśa is possible through wise thinking... and, as your soul is full with foulness, that unwise state of yours will never attain mokśa...' Rama Tilaka Commentary.

for a long time, one may live
to you [your-like,] is there, moksha, [release from the cycle of rebirth]
